title: Green Lantern #41
desc:
"GREEN LANTERN: FIRST LIGHT" PART 3!THE MYSTERIOUS VOICE REVEALED!

Of course, Hal Jordan didn't wait for backup to start a fight! But when backup arrives, before the tide can turn, the entire ocean flips over.

The source of the voice summoning Hal Jordan to the end of the emotional electromagnetic spectrum is revealed! And the Lanterns will never be the same!
